  | description     = Trick or Treat! Provides a +10 Festive Bonus to Magical Resistance Rating for 40 seconds. Eating a lot of candy can be bad for your health, though.

This candy grants {{Sheltering|10|Festive|Magical}} for 40 seconds when used. However, if you've used a different [[:C:Night Revels Candies|Night Revels Candy]] in your current rest, this item will also cause the effect [[Too Much Candy]], which makes a character [[nauseated]] for 20 seconds, ignoring saves and immunity.

  | notes        = This is effectively an Eternal Flask without a shared cooldown. However, the debuff attached effectively means you can only use one per rest.


Note that all Night Revels Candies will expire and become useless in early October, so you'll need to farm a new set from the next run of [[The Night Revels]].
